description: This file contains a test class `FormatWithNationalityTest` that extends a base test case class, and tests the functionality of the `FormatWithNationality` class related to formatting values based on nationality. It sets up fixture data, populates test data, and asserts expected formatted output values.

classes.name: FormatWithNationalityTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class that verifies the behavior of the `FormatWithNationality` class, ensuring correct formatted values based on fixture data.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test fixtures, loads configuration, populates test data, and instantiates the `FormatWithNationality` class.

methods.name: testGetFormattedValue
methods.description: Tests that the `getFormattedValue()` method of `FormatWithNationality` returns the expected string for input 1 and null for input 6.
